### The Power of a Gentle Invitation
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-power-of-a-gentle-invitation-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: John 1:43-46
Points:
- Believers often make the mistake of either trying to debate skeptics into faith or remaining completely silent.
- When Nathanael questioned whether anything good could come from Nazareth, Philip avoided arguing and simply issued a gentle invitation.
- Christians are called to be fellow travelers who walk beside others and point them toward spiritual discovery.
- Our role is to invite and remain present, trusting God to work directly in a person's heart to create lasting change.

### ‘Come and See More of Me’: Jesus’s Daily Invitation to Delight
Author: Brian Tabb
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/come-and-see-more-of-me
Passage: John 1:43-51
Points:
- Philip responded to Nathanael's skepticism not with debate, but by inviting him to experience Jesus firsthand.
- Jesus revealed that He intimately knew Nathanael's heart and declared Himself to be the place where heaven and earth meet.
- Believing in Jesus requires spiritual sight through faith rather than just a casual glance or historical familiarity.
- The call to encounter Christ is an ongoing invitation to keep discovering deeper measures of His divine glory.
